verdict.rationale: Linear's official "Rate limiting" docs publish exact per-auth request limits: API key 2,500/hr per user, OAuth app 5,000/hr per user, unauthenticated 600/hr per IP. They also document leaky-bucket refill, complexity limits and X-RateLimit response headers, so builders know their budgets before scaling automation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of concurrency caps (simultaneous requests or connections), independent or hands-on corroboration of the published limits.
